faq_heading: Homes near Heath Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Heath Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Heath Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Heath Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Heath Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 71 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,234,000, townhomes $945,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Heath Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Heath Elementary the median was 29 days on the market, closing at 96.1% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 71 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Heath Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Seaquam Secondary (0.8 km south-east), Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km north) and Cougar Canyon Elementary (0.9 km south-east).

Heath Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 11364 72 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Heath Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Heath Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Heath Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Heath Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 71 homes sold within 1 km of Heath Elementary: 62 houses and 8 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,234,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Heath Elementary

21 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Heath Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 6 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Seaquam Secondary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kennedy Trail Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (2.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km north), Cougar Canyon Elementary (0.9 km south-east), Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.9 km south), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (1.5 km north-east), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.8 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Chalmers Elementary, 0.8 km north of Heath Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Heath Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Heath Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Heath Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Heath Elementary was $1,234,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Chalmers Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km north of Heath Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
